summary: Rush Enterprises, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to a Canadian floor plan credit facility. The Fourth Amendment increased the loan commitment from CAD $171.7 million to CAD $194.7 million for subsidiary Rush Truck Centres of Canada Limited, with Rush Enterprises as guarantor. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation.
